mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app_user (id, auth_source, issuer, subject, username, display_name, email, enabled, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{authSource}, #{issuer}, #{subject}, #{username}, #{displayName}, #{email}, #{enabled}, now(), now())
mapper.select: SELECT id, auth_source, issuer, subject, username, display_name, email, enabled, created_at, updated_at FROM app_user WHERE id IN #{item}
